The user also doesn't know what his problems are, you have to identify that too - therefore, provide 4 multiple choice answers everytime. Ask a maximum of 25 questions until you suggest a product.

The product can be from any domain. Give it a name when you invent it a the end.
Only ask one question and skip pre-/and post text.
Base your next question on the previous answer.
